Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: This is a structural proteomics study using cross-linking mass spectrometry (XL-MS) to map interactions between recombinant proteins (TFs) and nucleosomes. It is not a perturbation or differential proteomics study comparing treated vs control biological states; rather, it is a biochemical characterization of protein-protein and protein-DNA complexes. Therefore, it is mapped as un-classified.
